terms.title: Ngā Tikanga me ngā Here
terms.s1_body: Mā te uru atu, mā te whakamahi rānei i te MyFutureAbroad, ka whakaae koe kia herea e ēnei Ngā Tikanga me Ngā Here. Mēnā kāore koe e whakaae, kaua e whakamahi i te papanga.
terms.s2_body: Ka whakarato a MyFutureAbroad i ngā mōhiohio me ngā taputapu hei āwhina i ngā tāngata e whakamahere ana ki te neke ki tāwāhi. He papa tēnei mō te whakamahinga whaiaro, kāore mō ngā whakamahinga hokohoko. Me kaua e whakamahi hē, e whakaparahako rānei i ngā āhuatanga o te ratonga.
terms.s3_body: Ka whakapau kaha mātou kia tika ngā pārongo mō ngā vīsa me ngā ratonga, engari kāore mātou e whakarato i ngā whakamana. Ka huri auau ngā ture manene — me whakamana tonu ngā taipitopito ki ngā puna mana a te kāwanatanga i mua i te whakatau.
terms.s4_body: Ka hono a MyFutureAbroad ki ngā ratonga a ētahi atu (hei tauira, Trip.com, ngā kaiwhakarato ratonga). Kāore mātou e kawenga mō te ihirangi, te tika, me ngā tikanga mahi a aua rōpū tuatoru.
terms.s5_body: I runga i te taumata katoa e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore a MyFutureAbroad e kawenga mō ngā ngaronga taha-rua, ngā ngaronga āpiti, me ngā ngaronga hua ka puta i tō whakamahi i te papa.
terms.s6_body: Ka taea e mātou te whakahou i ēnei Tikanga i ngā wā katoa. Mā te haere tonu ki te whakamahi i te papanga i muri i ngā panonitanga, ka whakaae koe ki ngā Tikanga hou.
terms.s7_body: Mēnā he pātai āu mō ēnei Tikanga, tēnā whakapā mai ki a mātou mā te whārangi Tautoko.

privacy.title: Pānui Tūmataitinga
privacy.s1_body: Ko MyFutureAbroad he papanga e āwhina ana i ngā tāngata ki te whakamahere me te whakahaere i tō rātou neke ki tāwāhi. Ko ngā tohutoro ki "we", "us", "our" e tohu ana ki MyFutureAbroad.
privacy.s2_title: 2. He aha ngā raraunga e kohia ana e mātou
privacy.s2_body: Ka kohia e mātou ngā pārongo ka tukuna e koe i te wā e waihanga ana i tētahi pūkete (ingoa, wāhitau īmēra) me ngā raraunga ka whakaputaina i tō whakamahi i te papanga (hei tauira: ngā visa kua penapenahia, ngā rārangi tirotiro, ngā tuhinga, ngā karere).
privacy.s3_title: 3. Me pēhea mātou e whakamahi ana i ō raraunga
privacy.s3_body: Ka whakamahia ō raraunga hei whakarato, hei whakapai ake i te ratonga MyFutureAbroad, hei whakarite i tō wheako, me te whakawhiti kōrero ki a koe mō tō pūkete, mō ō whakaritenga rānei. Kāore mātou e hoko i ō raraunga whaiaro ki ētahi atu rōpū tuatoru.
privacy.s4_body: Kei te penapenahia haumaru ō raraunga mā Supabase. Ka whakamahi mātou i ngā tikanga haumaru paerewa ā-umanga hei tiaki i ō pārongo.
privacy.s5_title: 5. Ngā kuki me te rokiroki ā-rohe
privacy.s5_body: Ka whakamahi mātou i te rokiroki ā-rohe o te pūtirotiro hei maumahara i ō manakohanga (hei tauira, te kaupapa, te whakamōhiotanga whakaae). Kāore he kuki aroturuki e whakanoho ki tō pūrere mehemea kāore tō whakaae.
privacy.s6_body: He tika āu ki te uru, ki te whakatika, ki te muku rānei i ō raraunga whaiaro i ngā wā katoa. Hei whakamahi i ēnei tika, whakapā mai ki a mātou mā te whārangi tautoko.
privacy.s7_body: Ka taea e mātou te whakahou i tēnei Pānui Tūmataitinga i ngā wā katoa. Ka whakamōhio atu mātou ki a koe mō ngā panonitanga nui mā te īmēra, mā tētahi pānui i roto i te taupānga rānei.
privacy.s8_body: Mō ngā pātai e pā ana ki te tūmataitinga, tēnā whakapā mai mā te whārangi tautoko.
